messages:
From: John Doe <john.doe@helix.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-10T09:12:23Z
Subject: Proposal: add-on capacity + rate swap for Q3 pilot

Laura —

Thanks for the time this morning. We want to move forward with the Q3 pilot but need a short-term capacity top-up and a temporary rate swap while we validate throughput. High level: +200 vGPU-hours / week for 12 weeks, proposed start 2028-06-01. We would like a blended per-token rate for the pilot (proposed in attachment) and proration for the month of June if the start date slips.

Can Redwood provide a change order and a quick turn on pricing? We need internal signoff by the end of next week.

Attached: Helix_OrderForm_Draft_v1.docx (order form with proposed quantities and suggested blended rate)

Thanks,
John
John Doe
Head of Platform, Helix Therapeutics

Date: 2028-05-10T11:01:05Z
Subject: Re: Proposal: add-on capacity + rate swap for Q3 pilot

John —

Appreciate the clear ask and the draft. We're aligned on the objective: short-term capacity top-up to support your pilot and a temporary blended rate while you validate consumption. Next steps from our side:

- I will circulate the draft change order (based on our change order template) for your review today.
- Looping in our legal (Markus) for redlines on MSA implications (billing proration, term, SLA, termination rights).
- Karthik will confirm final commercial approval / discount band and sign-off window.

Can you confirm: (1) if the blended rate is meant to apply to usage during the 12-week pilot only, and (2) whether you require any data-residency or special logging during the pilot? Those affect scope and potential SOW language.

Attaching our change order template to speed things up.

Atts: Redwood_ChangeOrder_Template.pdf

I'll aim to get the redline back by tomorrow EOD. If you need a DocuSign link instead of an attached PDF, let me know.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: John Doe <john.doe@helix.com>
Date: 2028-05-11T08:45:12Z
Subject: Re: Proposal: add-on capacity + rate swap for Q3 pilot — legal review

Laura / Karthik —

Quick legal read on John’s draft and Laura’s proposed approach. Inline summary of required redlines and clarifications before commercial approval / execution: 

1) Term and Scope: the change order must explicitly state the pilot term (12 weeks) and that the blended rate applies only to usage attributed to the pilot volumes. We should reference Exhibit X (Order Forms) and avoid changing the underlying MSA economics beyond the pilot term.

2) Billing / Proration: we can accept proration for June, but need a no-retroactive-charge clause (meaning we will not bill for usage before the effective date). Also require explicit language about invoice timing and dispute process.

3) SLA & Credits: for a temporary top-up, keep standard SLA language but cap credit exposure to the pilot fees (no open-ended liability increase).

4) Termination / Rollback: add a rollback clause allowing Redwood to revert to standard rates if pilot consumption materially exceeds forecasted thresholds (with 7 days notice). 

5) Data / Compliance: John, if you require additional logging or residency constraints, we need to capture that as an SOW attachment. Any EU residency requirements will trigger additional terms — please confirm.

6) Signatory Authority: ensure Helix signatory for the change order matches the MSA signatory. If different, we’ll need a short attestation.

I’m attaching a short redline (text) with suggested language snippets you can drop into the order form. Once commercial confirms the blended rate, I can convert the redline into track-changes in Word for Helix to review.

Atts: Redline_MSAText.txt

-Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redline_MSAText.txt (txt)]

From: John Doe <john.doe@helix.com>

Date: 2028-05-11T12:03:30Z
Subject: Re: Proposal: add-on capacity + rate swap for Q3 pilot — quick clarifications

Laura / Markus —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Couple quick points we can confirm here: 

• The blended rate is pilot-only for the 12-week window; Helix confirms it should not alter the underlying MSA beyond that period.
• We do not require EU residency for this pilot — US-only is fine.
• We accept an invoice proration approach but cannot accept retroactive charges; June start can be adjusted but billing should reflect the effective date.

We are fine with a rollback clause provided there’s an operational discussion prior to any rollback. Signatory will be our Sr. Procurement Director (name to follow) — I will get the attestation over.

Two asks: (1) can you push the redline into a Word doc with track changes so my procurement team can consume quicker? (2) we prefer DocuSign for signatures.

If you can circulate the tracked change Word and DocuSign link today, we’ll target signatures by 2028-05-18.

Best,
John
